I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is **#88412**.

It's the Tier 2 support escalation for the Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse tablet at Door 6, which froze when scanning the bill-of-lading barcode. Tobias posted it himself in #central-team on 2 July 2025. He's a member of that channel, so this is something he could already see.

In that same thread, the customer's night shift lead linked the freeze to Quarendon Freightways drivers arriving with split manifests. I couldn't find any later update on the ticket's status in what Tobias has access to, and I told him so.
